assembly.label: Toy California network: an approximate M7.8 scenario, for communication
assembly.description: A small, approximate chain from scenario to travel time, to show the workflow. The ground-motion model is a demo-only stand-in.

network_assumptions.direction: All connections are treated as undirected.
network_assumptions.length_km: Great-circle distance between endpoint coordinates using a spherical Earth radius of 6371.0088 km; not road distance.
network_assumptions.capacity: Each edge has placeholder capacity 1 in arbitrary units; no measured capacities were supplied.
network_assumptions.bridge_representation: One bridge per edge; these are synthetic bridges for the toy example.
network_assumptions.bridge_location: Each bridge is placed at the arithmetic mean of its edge endpoints latitude and longitude; not a surveyed location.
network_assumptions.bridge_class: Seven bridges HWB11 (seismically designed continuous concrete); b2, b4 and b6, the three nearest the San Andreas trace, HWB5 (older, non-seismic) for the demo. Toy assumptions, not an inventory classification.
network_assumptions.avg_speed_kph: 60 km/h on every edge, assumed (the value the rsr and ndtools demos use); no measured speeds are in the dataset.
network_assumptions.key_destination: Key destinations n1 and n2, as set by the user.
network_assumptions.event: Hypothetical M7.8 as a point source on the San Andreas trace at 36.50 N, 121.04 W, 10 km deep, for the demo only. This is the creeping section, not the 1857 rupture; a point source understates shaking along a ~300 km rupture.

source.purpose: DEMO ONLY, for communicating the workflow on toy-ca. Not a ground-motion model for California.
source.basis: The Campbell (2003) eastern North America numbers from campbell-2003.json, reused unchanged.

source.verification: Reproduced from user-supplied specification; full FEMA PDF retrieval returned HTTP 403
